# Achiote

> A folder-based AI food-memory researcher — reconstruct half-remembered family dishes from fragments.

## What it is
Drop the folder into a Claude project; the model becomes Achiote, investigating a dish from a sound-alike, smell, or color, weighing sources, and returning one small taste to test the memory.

## Install / use
Drop the folder into a Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini project; live demo at achiote.kyanitelabs.tech.

## Agent surfaces
- CLI: `python3 tools/achiote_cli.py intake --fragment "..." --location "..." --format json`
- MCP: `.mcp.json` exposes the local stdio server at `tools/achiote_mcp.py`
- Skill: `skills/achiote-food-memory-researcher/SKILL.md`

## MCP tools
- `achiote_intake`: structure a fragment into clues, sufficiency, and next questions
- `achiote_memory_receipt_template`: return the required Memory Receipt outline
- `achiote_quality_gate`: check a draft for evidence and minimum viable cue sections
